in_sanskrit.name: विषाल
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name 'Bishal' in Sanskrit means 'extensive, broad, wide, spacious'. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'visala', which means 'extensive' or 'broad'. This name is often given to children who are expected to have a wide range of experiences and opportunities in life.

in_hindi.name: विषाल
in_hindi.long_meaning: The name 'Bishal' in Hindi can be translated to 'vistarit' or 'extensive', 'sahay' or 'helpful', and 'swasth' or 'healthy'. This name is believed to bring good health, help, and extensive opportunities to the child.
